review_evidence: 00-complex-vectors.lisp: Defines complex/vector pair algebra (cplx, re, imz, cconj, cadd, cmul, dotp, crossp) and proves 5 theorems (eq6-dot-product-real-part, eq6-dot-product-imag-part, eq8-9-cross-product-real-part, eq8-9-cross-product-imag-part, eq9-im-ab-star-is-crossp) matching paper equations 6, 8-9
01-euler-identities.lisp: Encapsulates cosine/sine with 7 constraining axioms (Pythagorean, parity, angle-difference), defines eiz, proves eq10-euler-cosine and eq12-cosine-difference-is-dotp
02-roots-of-unity.lisp: Defines cube roots e0, e1(s3), e2(s3) with s3^2=3 hypothesis, proves sum-zero theorems for roots and double-angle
03-zeta-deduction.lisp: Defines current space vector ik, proves real/imag parts and magnitude-squared formula under balanced currents
04-collapse-lemma.lisp: Proves three-phase collapse lemma (eq33-35-three-phase-collapse-lemma) and mutual phase-shift identity (eq-mutual-phase-shift)
05-torque-sign-correction.lisp: Defines torque-W, proves conjugate property, W-W*/2j identity, and final torque-exponent-sign-is-plus theorem with nonvacuity witness
06-generic-omega-collapse.lisp: Proves generic collapse lemma for arbitrary omega satisfying omega^2+omega+1=0 via algebraic no-zero-divisors argument
06-generic-omega-collapse-acl2r.lisp: ACL2(r) companion constructing concrete omega=e^{j2pi/3} via acl2-cosine/acl2-sine, discharges conditional hypothesis
07-inductance-note.lisp: Documents non-mechanized integral section honestly; part of formalization boundary
08-inductance-integral.lisp: ACL2(r) progress on inductance integral: proves cos-product-to-sum, inductance-integrand-as-sum, and machine-derived sin-2x-minus-c-deriv via Reid-Gamboa differentiator
09-nonvacuity-acl2r.lisp: Instantiates books 03-05 at s3=acl2-sqrt(3), proves trig constraints for ACL2-COSINE/ACL2-SINE, functional-instantiates prior theorems
top-acl2r-nonvacuity.lisp, top-acl2r.lisp, top.lisp: Certification drivers organizing dependency chains for ACL2(r) and plain ACL2
cayuela-rectifiers/00-sampling-function.lisp: Defines Sa(x)=sin(x)/x, proves exact values at pi/6, pi/3, 2pi/3, pi/2, pi using ACL2(r) trig
cayuela-rectifiers/01-topology-instantiation.lisp: Instantiates master VCC/VRMS equations, proves coefficient theorems, discovers Table 1 inconsistency
cayuela-rectifiers/02-semiconverter-cross-checks.lisp: Proves three exact cross-checks at alpha=pi/3, 0, pi for semiconverter VRMS continuity and limits
cayuela-rectifiers/top.lisp: Certification driver for rectifier chain
